title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
title_zh: WorldSolver：大型语言模型智能体能否通过生成求解器来模拟物理动态？

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver , a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体正在日益推动科学与工程问题的解决，而物理模拟则逐渐成为一个富有挑战性且实用的测试平台，可用于复现复杂的物理现象，并应用于具身人工智能、游戏和电影领域。作为此类模拟的核心工具，求解器负责计算动态系统状态随时间的演化过程。构建这样的求解器需要物理学知识以识别合适的模型，数学推理以建立基础动力学方程，以及软件工程能力以将其实现为可执行的代码。然而，LLM 智能体在这一方面的能力仍尚未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了 WorldSolver——一个基准测试，包含 168 个模拟任务。这些任务源自 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文中描述的物理现象，涵盖 7 个物理领域。每个任务都提供了一个代码框架，为场景设定了固定的模拟环境，而求解器的具体实现则由智能体自行完成。具体而言，我们从三个维度对智能体的表现进行评估：执行检查（Execution Checks），用于判断执行是否成功；视觉保真度（Visual Fidelity），用于评估渲染出的模拟结果是否准确再现了预期的动态行为；以及物理合理性（Physical Plausibility），用于基于物理学原理验证所生成的动力学过程是否符合实际。对前沿智能体的实验表明，生成可执行的求解器本身就是一个难题，而同时满足视觉和物理上的正确性则更为困难。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 的表现相对优于其他受测智能体，但其综合得分分别仅为 48.7% 和 46.7%。WorldSolver 是迈向智能体驱动求解器生成的重要一步，我们希望它能推动智能体在忠实地模拟动态物理世界方面取得进步。代码可在 https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver 获取。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of tackling complex real-world tasks ( Huang et al., 2024b ; Guo et al., 2024 ) , spanning from software engineering ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Chi et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) to scientific discovery ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Majumder et al., 2024 ; Somasekharan et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies have shown growing interest in physically realistic simulation of 3D worlds, with broad applications in embodied AI, games, and films ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . A line of work focuses on static scene construction through asset composition and spatial layout ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . Another explores dynamic scene generation to reproduce physical phenomena and their temporal evolution ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在应对复杂的现实世界任务方面能力日益增强（Huang 等，2024b；Guo 等，2024），涵盖从软件工程（Jimenez 等，2024；Yang 等，2024；Chi 等，2026；Luo 等，2026）到科学发现（Huang 等，2024a；Majumder 等，2024；Somasekharan 等，2026）等多个领域。近期研究表明，对 3D 世界的物理真实模拟越来越受到关注，并在具身人工智能、游戏和电影等领域具有广泛应用（Liu 等，2026；Wang 等，2025）。一系列研究专注于通过资源组合与空间布局构建静态场景（Hu 等，2024；Xia 等，2025）。另一类研究则探索动态场景生成，以再现物理现象及其时间演化过程（Zhang 等，2026；Lv 等，2026；Xie 等，2026；Wang 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: As the workhorse of such simulation, solver translates the governing equations of a physical model into a numerical procedure that evolves the simulated system over time ( Baraff and Witkin, 2023 ; Stam, 1999 ) . Building them requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code ( Guendelman et al., 2003 ) . For example, cloth solver handles stiff elastic dynamics and frictional contact at high degrees of freedom ( Li et al., 2018 ) , while fluid solver instead focuses on incompressibility enforcement and free-surface tracking ( Enright et al., 2002 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 作为此类模拟的核心工具，求解器将物理模型的控制方程转化为一种数值过程，该过程使被模拟的系统随时间演化（Baraff 和 Witkin，2023；Stam，1999）。构建求解器需要物理学知识以识别合适的模型，数学推理以建立其底层动力学，以及软件工程能力以将其实现为可执行的代码（Guendelman 等，2003）。例如，布料求解器能够处理高自由度下的刚性弹性动力学和摩擦接触（Li 等，2018），而流体求解器则专注于不可压缩性的约束和自由表面的追踪（Enright 等，2002）。

paragraphs.en: However, existing works target dynamics scene generation either produce animations in a solver-free manner ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or rely on existing simulation engine ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, scientific-computing benchmarks evaluate numerical solver generation for prescribed governing equations, where the physical model to be solved is given in advance ( Li et al., 2026 ; Hang et al., 2026 ; Somasekharan et al., 2026 ) . Neither setting evaluates the full capability required for physical dynamics simulation, spanning physical understanding for model selection, mathematical reasoning for numerical formulation, and software engineering for executable implementation. Together, they motivate our question:
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有研究针对动态场景生成，要么以无需求解器的方式生成动画（Wang 等人，2026），要么依赖现有的模拟引擎（Zhang 等人，2026；Xie 等人，2026；Liu 等人，2026）。相比之下，科学计算基准测试则评估针对预定控制方程的数值求解器生成能力，其中待求解的物理模型是预先给定的（Li 等人，2026；Hang 等人，2026；Somasekharan 等人，2026）。这两种设定均未评估物理动态模拟所需的全部能力，包括模型选择所需的物理理解、数值公式构建所需的数学推理，以及可执行实现所需的软件工程。这些研究共同引出了我们的问题：

paragraphs.en: Can LLM agents turn described physical phenomena into dynamics simulation solvers?
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型智能体能否将描述性的物理现象转化为动力学模拟求解器？

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present WorldSolver , a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents’ ability to generate solvers for physical dynamics simulation tasks. As shown in Figure 1 , WorldSolver isolates solver generation with a fixed code scaffold and evaluates the generated physical dynamics through the state trajectory and rendered video outputs. To ensure a challenging yet physically realistic setting, we curate physical phenomena from classic computer graphics literature and construct simulation tasks around them ( Guendelman et al., 2003 ; Kaufman et al., 2005 ; Li et al., 2018 ) . Given a description of the target phenomenon, the agent implements a solver within a fixed code scaffold that specifies the simulation environment, including scene geometry, physical parameters, external inputs, and rendering configuration. Once executed, the solver produces not only a rendered video but also a state trajectory that exposes the underlying physical dynamics through evolving quantities over time , such as position, velocity, and forces.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了 WorldSolver——一个用于评估 LLM 智能体生成物理动力学模拟任务求解器能力的基准测试。如图 1 所示，WorldSolver 通过固定的代码框架将求解器生成过程独立出来，并通过状态轨迹和渲染视频输出来评估所生成的物理动力学效果。为了确保测试环境既具挑战性又符合物理现实，我们从经典的计算机图形学文献中精选了多种物理现象，并围绕这些现象构建模拟任务（Guendelman et al., 2003；Kaufman et al., 2005；Li et al., 2018）。在给定目标现象的描述后，智能体将在一个固定的代码框架内实现求解器，该框架定义了模拟环境，包括场景几何结构、物理参数、外部输入和渲染配置。执行完成后，求解器不仅会生成一段渲染视频，还会产生一条状态轨迹，通过随时间演变的物理量（如位置、速度和力）揭示其底层的物理动力学过程。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we evaluate each solver through three protocols: Execution Checks for successful and complete execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered video, and Physical Plausibility for physically-grounded verification of the generated trajectory. Table 1 summarizes how WorldSolver differs from existing benchmarks in task formulation and evaluation. Evaluation on the WorldSolver benchmark shows that generating executable solvers from described physical phenomena remains challenging even for frontier coding agents. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform best, yet reach overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, while most other agents hover around 20%. Our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们通过三种协议对每个求解器进行评估：执行检查（Execution Checks），用于验证执行是否成功且完整；视觉保真度（Visual Fidelity），用于评估渲染视频中预期动态行为的再现程度；以及物理合理性（Physical Plausibility），用于对生成的轨迹进行基于物理原理的验证。表1总结了WorldSolver在任务构建和评估方面与现有基准测试的差异。对WorldSolver基准测试的评估表明，即使对于前沿编码智能体而言，从描述的物理现象中生成可执行的求解器仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-5的表现最佳，但其总分仅为48.7%和46.7%，而大多数其他智能体的得分则在20%左右。我们的贡献主要有三个方面：

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to formulate physical dynamics solver generation as an agentic coding task, where agents’ capabilities in physical understanding, mathematical formalization and software engineering are put to the test.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们是首次将物理动力学求解器生成问题表述为一个智能体编码任务，其中智能体在物理理解、数学形式化以及软件工程方面的能力都将受到检验。

paragraphs.en: We introduce WorldSolver , comprising 168 tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers across seven domains, with fixed task-specific scaffolds that isolate solver implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldSolver，它包含从 7 个领域的 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文中的物理现象衍生出的 168 项任务，并采用固定的任务特定框架，以隔离求解器的实现细节。

paragraphs.en: We propose an evaluation protocol combining execution checks, rendered-simulation assessment, and physics-grounded trajectory verification, benchmarking frontier coding agents under this unified protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种评估协议，该协议结合了执行检查、渲染模拟评估和基于物理的轨迹验证，并在此统一协议下对前沿编码智能体进行基准测试。

paragraphs.en: WorldSolver is a benchmark that evaluates how well coding agents can generate solvers for physical simulation. Each task is derived from a challenging yet physically realistic phenomenon, curated from classic computer graphics papers spanning seven physical domains. Overview of the WorldSolver workflow is provided in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: WorldSolver 是一项基准测试，用于评估编码智能体在生成物理模拟求解器方面的能力。每个任务都源于一个具有挑战性但物理上真实的现象，这些现象是从涵盖七个物理领域的经典计算机图形学论文中精选而来的。WorldSolver 的工作流程概述见图 2。

paragraphs.en: Each task provides a description d d of a target physical phenomenon and a fixed code scaffold
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都提供了一个目标物理现象的描述 d d 和一个固定的代码框架

paragraphs.en: where 𝒢 \mathcal{G} specifies scene geometry and assets, 𝒫 \mathcal{P} specifies physical parameters, external inputs, and boundary conditions, ℰ \mathcal{E} defines the execution protocol and solver interface, and ℛ \mathcal{R} specifies the rendering configuration. The scaffold provides the infrastructure for executing and rendering a simulation. We then formulate physics solver generation as a task in which an agent A A develops a solver Φ \Phi from a description d d of a target phenomenon and a fixed code scaffold 𝒮 \mathcal{S} :
paragraphs.zh: 其中，𝒢 \mathcal{G} 指定场景几何与资产，𝒫 \mathcal{P} 指定物理参数、外部输入和边界条件，ℰ \mathcal{E} 定义执行协议和求解器接口，而 ℛ \mathcal{R} 则指定渲染配置。该框架为执行和渲染模拟提供了基础架构。随后，我们将物理求解器生成表述为一项任务：智能体 A A 根据目标现象的描述 d d 和固定的代码框架 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，开发出一个求解器 Φ \Phi：

paragraphs.en: A solver Φ \Phi defines how the state of a simulated system evolves over time. Let 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} denote the physical state at step t t , and let 𝐬 0 \mathbf{s}_{0} be the initial state defined by the scaffold. Executed under the scaffold’s protocol, Φ \Phi advances each state to the next one over a horizon of T T steps:
paragraphs.zh: 求解器 Φ \Phi 定义了模拟系统的状态如何随时间演化。令 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} 表示第 t t 步的物理状态，并令 𝐬 0 \mathbf{s}_{0} 为框架所定义的初始状态。在框架协议的执行下，Φ \Phi 会将每个状态推进到下一个状态，整个过程跨越 T T 步的时间范围：

paragraphs.en: Each state 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} exports necessary variables for rendering and quantities required by physical checks, such as velocities and contact forces.
paragraphs.zh: 每个状态 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} 都会输出渲染所需的必要变量以及物理检查所要求的量，例如速度和接触力。

paragraphs.en: Finally, each run produces two outputs for evaluation. Iterating state 𝐬 T \mathbf{s}_{T} collects a state trajectory τ \tau , and passing the trajectory through the fixed renderer yields a video v v .
paragraphs.zh: 最后，每次运行都会生成两个输出用于评估。迭代状态 𝐬 T \mathbf{s}_{T} 会收集一条状态轨迹 τ \tau ，而将这条轨迹输入固定的渲染器，则会生成一段视频 v v 。

paragraphs.en: We curate our tasks from challenging yet physically realistic phenomena presented in classic computer graphics papers ( Guendelman et al., 2003 ; Li et al., 2018 ; Enright et al., 2002 ) . For each phenomenon, we write a task description together with a set of scoring criteria, the latter withheld from the agent during solver generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从经典计算机图形学论文中提出的具有挑战性但物理上逼真的现象中挑选任务（Guendelman 等人，2003；Li 等人，2018；Enright 等人，2002）。对于每种现象，我们都会编写一项任务描述以及一套评分标准，其中评分标准在生成求解器时不会提供给智能体。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark covers seven domains, including fluid ( Jiang et al., 2015 ; De Goes et al., 2015 ) , rigid body ( Kaufman et al., 2005 ; Ferguson et al., 2021 ) , plastic and complex materials ( Klár et al., 2016 ; Stomakhin et al., 2013 ) , elastic solids ( Li et al., 2020 ; Irving et al., 2007 ) , rods and strands ( Bergou et al., 2008 ; Bertails et al., 2006 ) , cloth and shells ( Li et al., 2021 ; Bridson et al., 2002 ) , and multiphysics coupling ( Batty et al., 2007 ; Guendelman et al., 2005 ) . Figure 3 shows how the tasks distribute across these domains, along with a representative case from each.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试涵盖了七个领域，包括流体（Jiang 等人，2015；De Goes 等人，2015）、刚体（Kaufman 等人，2005；Ferguson 等人，2021）、塑性材料和复杂材料（Klár 等人，2016；Stomakhin 等人，2013）、弹性固体（Li 等人，2020；Irving 等人，2007）、杆和细丝（Bergou 等人，2008；Bertails 等人，2006）、布料和壳结构（Li 等人，2021；Bridson 等人，2002），以及多物理场耦合（Batty 等人，2007；Guendelman 等人，2005）。图3展示了这些任务在这些领域中的分布情况，并附上了每个领域的代表性案例。

paragraphs.en: We turn each description into a fixed code scaffold 𝒮 = ( 𝒢 , 𝒫 , ℰ , ℛ ) \mathcal{S}=(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{P},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{R}) automatically with manual checks. The geometry 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and the physical setup 𝒫 \mathcal{P} define what is simulated, from object shapes and arrangements to physical parameters and boundary conditions. The execution protocol ℰ \mathcal{E} and the rendering setup ℛ \mathcal{R} define how it is run and observed, fixing the solver interface and trajectory format on one side and the cameras and appearance on the other. Each agent receives the task prompt d d and the same scaffold 𝒮 \mathcal{S} for a given task, with modifications restricted to solver code so that modeling and numerical choices and code engineering are evaluated under controlled conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过人工检查，将每个描述自动转换为固定的代码框架 𝒮 = ( 𝒢 , 𝒫 , ℰ , ℛ ) \mathcal{S}=(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{P},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{R})。几何结构 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 和物理设置 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 定义了模拟的内容，包括物体形状与排列、物理参数以及边界条件。执行协议 ℰ \mathcal{E} 和渲染设置 ℛ \mathcal{R} 定义了模拟的运行与观察方式：一方面固定了求解器接口和轨迹格式，另一方面则确定了摄像头和外观表现。对于给定的任务，每个智能体都会收到任务提示 d d 以及相同的框架 𝒮 \mathcal{S}；其中，允许修改的部分仅限于求解器代码，从而确保建模、数值选择及代码工程都在受控条件下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate submitted solvers along three axes: Execution Checks, Visual Fidelity, and Physical Plausibility. Together, they assess whether a solver runs successfully, reproduces the expected visible phenomena, and respects the relevant physical laws and constraints, with the visual and physical evidence serving as complementary views of simulation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个维度对提交的求解器进行评估：执行检查、视觉保真度和物理合理性。这三个维度共同评估一个求解器是否能够成功运行、重现预期的可见现象，并遵循相关的物理定律和约束条件，其中视觉证据和物理证据可作为模拟质量的互补视角。

paragraphs.en: We first run each solver under the code scaffold 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , setting the execution score E = 1 E=1 if it completes successfully and produces valid output and E = 0 E=0 otherwise. For successful executions, the resulting state trajectory τ \tau and rendered video v v are passed to the physical and visual evaluations described below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在每个代码框架 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 下运行每个求解器：如果求解器成功执行并生成有效输出，则设置执行分数 E = 1；否则设置 E = 0。对于成功执行的案例，所得的状态轨迹 τ 和渲染出的视频 v 将被传入下文描述的物理和视觉评估环节。

paragraphs.en: Visual Fidelity V V measures how well the rendered simulation reproduces the task’s target phenomena. For each task, we specify a set of visual criteria 𝒞 = { c i } i = 1 4 \mathcal{C}=\{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{4} across the four shared dimensions shown in Table 2 . We use a Vision-Language Model ( VLM ) to score each criterion c i c_{i} from sampled key frames of the rendered video v v , and the Visual Fidelity score is their average:
paragraphs.zh: 视觉保真度 V V 衡量渲染后的模拟在多大程度上再现了任务的目标现象。对于每个任务，我们根据表 2 中列出的四个共享维度，定义一组视觉标准 𝒞 = { c i } i = 1 4 \mathcal{C}=\{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{4}。我们使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）对渲染视频 v v 中采样得到的关键帧的每个标准 c i c_{i} 进行评分，而视觉保真度分数则是这些评分的平均值：

paragraphs.en: To validate the VLM judge, we evaluate its stability and compare its assessments with those of human experts, as further discussed in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证 VLM 判断器，我们评估了其稳定性，并将其评估结果与人类专家的评估结果进行了比较，更多讨论见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: A solver outputs the physical state at every time step, enabling continuous verification beyond the discrete observations used for visual evaluation. Specifically, Physical Plausibility P P verifies whether the generated trajectory τ \tau respects relevant physical laws and constraints. For each physical domain, we predefine a set of violation functions ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} for laws, such as mass conservation, momentum–impulse consistency, and contact nonpenetration. For each case, we define a task-specific rule set ℛ = { r i } i = 1 M \mathcal{R}={\{r_{i}\}}_{i=1}^{M} based on the relevant physical properties of the simulated phenomenon, with M M typically ranging from 3 to 5. Required output properties are specified in the solver-generation prompt, while the physical laws used for evaluation remain hidden from the agent. Each rule r i r_{i} is evaluated by a calculator ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} that computes a nonnegative, dimensionless violation error e i e_{i} :

paragraphs.en: We evaluate seven frontier models on the WorldSolver benchmark: GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.7-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3 ( Zhipu AI, 2026 ) , Qwen-3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and Kimi-K2.7-Code ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) . We use Codex CLI as the agent scaffold for GPT-5.6-Sol and Kimi Code for Kimi-K2.7-Code, while all other models are evaluated with Claude Code. For each model, we use the reasoning-effort setting of “high” when available, models without explicit levels are evaluated with thinking mode “enabled”. We set a generation time limit of 1,800 seconds for each agent and a runtime limit of 600 seconds for each generated solver. We use GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as the VLM judge and sample 20 key frames from each rendered video for evaluation. For clarity, all benchmark scores are reported on a 0–100 scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 WorldSolver 基准测试上评估了七款前沿模型：GPT-5.6-Sol（OpenAI，2026）、Claude-Opus-5（Anthropic，2026）、Gemini-3.7-Flash（Google DeepMind，2026）、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）、GLM-5.3（Zhipu AI，2026）、Qwen-3.8-Max（Qwen Team，2026）以及 Kimi-K2.7-Code（Moonshot AI，2026）。对于 GPT-5.6-Sol，我们使用 Codex CLI 作为智能体框架；对于 Kimi-K2.7-Code，则使用 Kimi Code。其余所有模型均使用 Claude Code 进行评估。对于每个模型，如果可用，我们会将推理努力程度设置为“高”；没有明确级别的模型则会启用思考模式进行评估。我们为每个智能体设置了 1,800 秒的生成时间限制，并为每个生成的求解器设置了 600 秒的运行时间限制。我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol（OpenAI，2026）作为 VLM 评判模型，并从每个渲染后的视频中采样 20 个关键帧进行评估。为清晰起见，所有基准测试分数均以 0–100 的评分标准报告。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows that physical dynamics solver generation remains challenging for the evaluated agents. GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest overall score of 48.7%, followed closely by Claude-Opus-5 at 46.7%. Gemini-3.7-Flash scores 29.3%, while DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3, Qwen-3.8-Max, and Kimi-K2.7-Code obtain 24.6%, 23.6%, 22.7%, and 17.1%, respectively. The performance gaps across models are substantial, yet none of the evaluated agents demonstrates consistently strong solver-generation performance. We also provide detailed Visual Fidelity and Physical Plausibility results for each agent across all domains in the Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 表3显示，对于所评估的智能体而言，物理动力学求解器的生成仍然具有挑战性。GPT-5.6-Sol 以48.7%的总得分位居第一，Claude-Opus-5紧随其后，得分为46.7%。Gemini-3.7-Flash的得分为29.3%，而DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3、Qwen-3.8-Max和Kimi-K2.7-Code的得分分别为24.6%、23.6%、22.7%和17.1%。各模型之间的性能差距显著，但所有被评估的智能体均未展现出稳定且出色的求解器生成能力。此外，我们在附录D中提供了各智能体在所有领域中的详细视觉保真度和物理合理性结果。

paragraphs.en: Domain-level performance. Each agent shows substantial performance variation across different physical domains. GPT-5.6-Sol performs best on Fluid, Rigid Body, Rods and Strands, and Multiphysics Coupling, whereas Claude-Opus-5 leads on Plastic and Complex Materials, Elastic Solids, and Cloth and Shells. Although their overall scores differ by only 2 points, their domain-level gaps are much larger: GPT-5.6-Sol outperforms Claude-Opus-5 by 26% on Rods and Strands, while Claude-Opus-5 leads by 24.3% on Cloth and Shells. Several agents also show weaknesses in specific domains, for example, Gemini-3.7-Flash scores only 9.5% on Cloth and Shells, and GLM-5.3 scores 7.0% on Multiphysics Coupling.
paragraphs.zh: 领域级表现。每个智能体在不同物理领域的表现存在显著差异。GPT-5.6-Sol 在流体、刚体、杆与细丝以及多物理场耦合方面表现最佳，而 Claude-Opus-5 则在塑性材料、复杂材料、弹性固体以及织物与壳体方面领先。尽管它们的总得分仅相差 2 分，但领域级差距要大得多：GPT-5.6-Sol 在杆与细丝领域的表现比 Claude-Opus-5 高出 26%，而 Claude-Opus-5 在织物与壳体领域则领先 24.3%。一些智能体在某些特定领域也存在薄弱环节，例如，Gemini-3.7-Flash 在织物与壳体领域的得分仅为 9.5%，而 GLM-5.3 在多物理场耦合领域的得分为 7.0%。

paragraphs.en: Success rate across different stages. Generating a reliable solver for physical dynamics simulation remains challenging: most agents return a submission, fewer produce valid simulation outputs, and fewer still pass the benchmark threshold. As shown in Figure 4 , Solver Submitted denotes the fraction of tasks with a solver returned in time, Trajectory Produced the fraction whose solver successfully exports both a trajectory and a rendered video, and Cases Passed the fraction achieving a final score of at least 60%. We use 60 as a preliminary threshold to illustrate the stage-wise trend, rather than as an established criterion for solver success. All models submit solvers for most tasks, with rates ranging from 88% to 100%. However, substantially fewer solvers produce valid outputs, from 82% for GPT-5.6-Sol to 38% for Kimi-K2.7-Code. Passing the benchmark threshold is harder still. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 pass 41% and 37% of cases, compared with 14% for Qwen-3.8-Max and 8% for Kimi-K2.7-Code. The largest separation appears at the execution stage, where GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 reach 82% and 79%, while the remaining models range from 38% to 54%. This gap is most striking for Kimi-K2.7-Code, which submits a solver for 99% of tasks but produces valid simulation outputs for only 38%.
paragraphs.zh: 不同阶段的成功率。为物理动力学模拟生成可靠的求解器仍然是一项挑战：大多数智能体返回一个求解器，较少数能生成有效的模拟输出，而通过基准测试阈值的则更少。如图4所示，“提交求解器”表示按时返回求解器的任务比例，“生成轨迹”表示其求解器成功导出轨迹和渲染视频的占比，“通过案例”则表示最终得分至少达到60%的案例比例。我们使用60作为初步阈值来说明各阶段的趋势，而非将其视为衡量求解器成功与否的既定标准。所有模型在大多数任务中都能提交求解器，提交率介于88%至100%之间。然而，能够生成有效输出的求解器数量要少得多：GPT-5.6-Sol为82%，而Kimi-K2.7-Code仅为38%。通过基准测试阈值则更为困难。GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-5分别通过了41%和37%的案例，相比之下，Qwen-3.8-Max为14%，Kimi-K2.7-Code仅为8%。最大的差异出现在执行阶段：GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-5分别达到了82%和79%，而其他模型的通过率则在38%至54%之间。这一差距在Kimi-K2.7-Code上尤为显著：它在99%的任务中提交了求解器，但仅有38%的任务生成了有效的模拟输出。

paragraphs.en: Visualization of generated solver dynamics. Figure 5 shows the temporal evolution of representative solver across three physical dynamics simulation tasks at matched video timestamps. In the buoyant smoke example (a), Claude-Opus-5 produces a visually natural rising plume with irregular billowing structures that spread beneath the upper boundary. Gemini-3.7-Flash develops a more symmetric column with visibly separated particle structures, while Kimi-K2.7-Code shows a transient rise followed by substantial fading, rather than sustained plume development. In the dam-break example (b), Claude-Opus-5’s fluid spreads around the arch and into the downstream region, whereas GPT-5.6-Sol’s fluid remains largely upstream over the displayed interval. Qwen-3.8-Max instead exhibits extensive airborne particle dispersion, without a comparably continuous body of flowing liquid. In the Newton cradle example (c), GPT-5.6-Sol and Gemini-3.7-Flash show the initially displaced end ball approaching the row and the opposite end ball subsequently swinging outward, with relatively little interior motion. Kimi-K2.7-Code exhibits large displacements of multiple interior balls, departing from the intended impulse-transfer behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的求解器动态可视化。图5展示了在匹配的视频时间戳下，三个物理动态模拟任务中代表性求解器的时间演化过程。在浮力烟雾示例（a）中，Claude-Opus-5生成了视觉上自然的上升烟柱，其具有不规则的波动结构，并向上边界下方扩散。Gemini-3.7-Flash则形成了更对称的柱状结构，粒子结构清晰分离；而Kimi-K2.7-Code则表现出短暂的上升，随后显著减弱，而非持续形成烟柱。在堤坝决口示例（b）中，Claude-Opus-5的流体绕过拱形结构并流入下游区域，而GPT-5.6-Sol的流体在所展示的时间区间内基本停留在上游。相比之下，Qwen-3.8-Max则表现出大量悬浮粒子的扩散，但并未形成同样连续的流动液体体。在牛顿摆示例（c）中，GPT-5.6-Sol和Gemini-3.7-Flash显示，初始被推动的末端小球接近球列，随后另一端的小球向外摆动，内部小球几乎没有明显运动。而Kimi-K2.7-Code则表现出多个内部小球的较大位移，偏离了预期的动量传递行为。

paragraphs.en: Agent behavior patterns in solver generation. Figure 6 shows differences in average epoch counts and tool usage. GPT-5.6-Sol uses the fewest model-call epochs on average of 13.07, while achieving the highest benchmark score. However, Kimi-K2.7-Code requires 37.95 epochs, nearly three times as many, yet performs substantially worse. These results show that more model calls do not consistently yield better solvers. Figure 6 (a) to (d) shows that Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6 Sol allocate 25.3% and 12.5% of their tool calls to Edit, compared with 8.2% for Gemini-3.7-Flash and 2.5% for Kimi-K2.7-Code. This pattern suggests a potential association between a greater emphasis on code revision and better solver performance.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在求解器生成中的行为模式。图6展示了平均轮次数和工具使用方面的差异。GPT-5.6-Sol 的平均模型调用轮次数最少，为13.07轮，同时取得了最高的基准分数。然而，Kimi-K2.7-Code需要37.95轮，几乎是前者的三倍，但其表现却明显更差。这些结果表明，更多的模型调用并不总能产生更好的求解器。图6（a）至（d）显示，Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6 Sol将其工具调用的25.3%和12.5%分配给了“编辑”操作，而Gemini-3.7-Flash和Kimi-K2.7-Code的这一比例分别为8.2%和2.5%。这一模式表明，更重视代码修订与更好的求解器性能之间可能存在关联。

paragraphs.en: Cost effectiveness . Figure 7 compares benchmark performance with average API cost and wall time. GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest score at a lower API cost than Claude-Opus-5, while requiring less than half its average wall time (8.89 versus 18.59 minutes), which is consistent with the mean model-call epochs data. Gemini-3.7-Flash offers a cheaper and much faster alternative, with the shortest average wall time of 2.59 minutes, although its score is lower. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash achieves the best cost-effectiveness, but accompanied by high token usage and longer wall time. Conversely, Kimi-K2.7-Code incurs a higher API cost and longer wall time than GPT-5.6-Sol despite weaker performance, which is related to its overthinking tendency.
paragraphs.zh: 成本效益。图 7 比较了基准性能与平均 API 成本和实际运行时间。GPT-5.6-Sol 在比 Claude-Opus-5 更低的 API 成本下获得了最高分，同时其平均实际运行时间不到后者的二分之一（8.89 分钟对比 18.59 分钟），这与平均模型调用轮次数据一致。Gemini-3.7-Flash 提供了一个更便宜且快得多的替代方案，平均实际运行时间最短，为 2.59 分钟，尽管其得分较低。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 实现了最佳成本效益，但也伴随着较高的令牌使用量和更长的实际运行时间。相反，Kimi-K2.7-Code 的性能较弱，但 API 成本和实际运行时间却高于 GPT-5.6-Sol，这与它过度思考的倾向有关。

paragraphs.en: Code Generation Benchmarks. Code generation aims to translate natural-language specifications into executable programs ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ) . As an early milestone, HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) focuses on generating standalone Python functions and evaluates their correctness through execution. With the increasing capability of LLM-based agents, recent work has moved beyond function-level generation toward more complex repository-level tasks. One line of work extends code generation to complex software development tasks, including software engineering ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Miserendino et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) and game development ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Chi et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Another line extends code generation to scientific tasks, including implementing scientific ideas ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Majumder et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) and developing computational tools for scientific computing ( Li et al., 2026 ; Hang et al., 2026 ; Somasekharan et al., 2026 ) . WorldSolver bridges these two directions by generating physics simulation solvers for described phenomena. On the one hand, it requires agents to develop and modify physics simulation systems at the repository level. On the other hand, agents must use physical understanding to select appropriate models and mathematical reasoning to formulate numerical methods.
paragraphs.zh: 代码生成基准测试。代码生成旨在将自然语言规范转换为可执行的程序（Chen 等人，2021；Austin 等人，2021；Hendrycks 等人，2021；Li 等人，2022）。作为早期的一个里程碑，HumanEval（Chen 等人，2021）专注于生成独立的 Python 函数，并通过执行来评估其正确性。随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体能力不断增强，近期的研究已超越函数级别的生成，转向更复杂的仓库级别任务。其中一类研究将代码生成扩展到复杂的软件开发任务，包括软件工程（Jimenez 等人，2024；Miserendino 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2024）和游戏开发（Jiang 等人，2026；Chi 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2026）。另一类研究则将代码生成扩展到科学任务，包括实现科学思想（Huang 等人，2024a；Majumder 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2025）以及开发用于科学计算的计算工具（Li 等人，2026；Hang 等人，2026；Somasekharan 等人，2026）。WorldSolver 通过为所描述的现象生成物理模拟求解器，将这两个方向连接起来。一方面，它要求智能体在仓库级别上开发并修改物理模拟系统；另一方面，智能体必须运用物理知识来选择适当的模型，并通过数学推理来构建数值方法。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous Physics Simulation. Constructing a physical scene begins with specifying its static configuration, including object geometry, material properties, and initial and boundary conditions. Thanks to the development of LLM models, works in autonomous physics simulation based on LLM agents have emerged recently. SimuScene evaluates code-generated animations through visible behavior ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , while PhysCodeBench, GS-Agent, and PhysAgent construct dynamic simulations using pre-built physics engines ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) . Neither setting directly evaluates the full process of selecting physical models and implementing solvers for diverse graphics scenes under fixed experimental conditions. CodePDE, CFD-CodeBench, and PDEAgent-Bench study solver generation for prescribed equations, evaluating solution accuracy, convergence, or computational efficiency ( Li et al., 2026 ; Somasekharan et al., 2026 ; Hang et al., 2026 ) . These settings primarily focus on scientific computing, without specific physical scenarios or rendering environments, leaving agents’ physical understanding and mathematical modeling abilities largely unevaluated. WorldSolver instead fixes the scene conditions and requires agents to both select physical models and implement numerical solvers without a pre-built physics engine. Its evaluation combines visible behavior with trajectory-based physical checks across seven domains.
paragraphs.zh: 自主物理模拟。构建物理场景首先需要明确其静态配置，包括物体几何形状、材料属性以及初始和边界条件。得益于大型语言模型（LLM）的发展，近期出现了基于 LLM 智能体的自主物理模拟研究。SimuScene 通过可观察的行为来评估代码生成的动画（Wang 等，2026），而 PhysCodeBench、GS-Agent 和 PhysAgent 则利用预构建的物理引擎来创建动态模拟（Xie 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Lv 等，2026）。这些设置均未在固定实验条件下直接评估为不同图形场景选择物理模型并实现求解器的完整过程。CodePDE、CFD-CodeBench 和 PDEAgent-Bench 则研究针对预设方程的求解器生成，并评估解的准确性、收敛性或计算效率（Li 等，2026；Somasekharan 等，2026；Hang 等，2026）。这些设置主要聚焦于科学计算，缺乏具体的物理场景或渲染环境，因此智能体在物理理解和数学建模方面的能力在很大程度上尚未得到评估。相比之下，WorldSolver 固定了场景条件，并要求智能体在没有预构建物理引擎的情况下同时选择物理模型并实现数值求解器。其评估方法结合了可观察的行为与基于轨迹的物理验证，涵盖七个不同领域。

paragraphs.en: We introduced WorldSolver, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can translate physical phenomena description into executable physics solvers. It comprises 168 tasks drawn from 61 computer graphics papers across seven physical domains. Under fixed code scaffolds, agents implement solvers whose outputs are assessed through execution checks, visual fidelity, and physical plausibility. Our experiments show that reliable solver generation remains highly challenging: many agents struggle to submit a runnable solver within the time budget, and even fewer produce solvers that are both visually faithful and physically plausible. WorldSolver provides a testbed for studying physically grounded computation through agent-generated solvers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldSolver，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体能否将物理现象描述转化为可执行的物理求解器的基准测试。该基准测试包含 168 个任务，这些任务源自涵盖七个物理领域的 61 篇计算机图形学论文。在固定的代码框架下，智能体会实现求解器，其输出将通过执行检查、视觉保真度和物理合理性进行评估。我们的实验表明，可靠地生成求解器仍然极具挑战性：许多智能体难以在时间限制内提交一个可运行的求解器，而能够同时生成视觉保真且物理合理的求解器的智能体则更少。WorldSolver 为通过智能体生成的求解器研究基于物理的计算提供了一个测试平台。

paragraphs.en: WorldSolver covers seven physical domains with 168 tasks, but still represents only a subset of physical phenomena. In the future, we can expand this coverage and explore training methods for physically grounded solver generation.
paragraphs.zh: WorldSolver 涵盖了七个物理领域和 168 项任务，但仍然只代表了物理现象的一个子集。未来，我们可以扩展这一覆盖范围，并探索基于物理原理的求解器生成训练方法。

paragraphs.en: To curate phenomena that are challenging yet physically realistic, we survey computer graphics papers across seven domains and assemble a candidate pool. Then, we let human experts filter this pool to ensure task quality. A candidate is retained only if: (1) the phenomenon is visually identifiable; (2) a deterministic scene can be constructed; (3) the observable events can be stated explicitly; (4) the relevant physical quantities can be computed from raw solver outputs. To keep the benchmark diverse, the experts further merge candidates that share the same objects, geometry, initial state, and target event and differ only in parameter setting. For example, the two-meter-high, ten-body rigid stack settling under gravity appears in its source paper both with and without mass scaling; we keep it as a single task. The resulting benchmark consists of 168 tasks curated from 61 reference papers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了筛选出既具有挑战性又符合物理现实的现象，我们对七个领域的计算机图形学论文进行了调研，并组建了一个候选池。随后，我们请人类专家对这一候选池进行筛选，以确保任务的质量。一个候选项仅在所有以下条件均满足时才会被保留：(1) 该现象在视觉上可被识别；(2) 能够构建一个确定性的场景；(3) 可观察的事件能够被明确描述；(4) 相关的物理量能够从求解器的原始输出中计算得出。为保持基准测试的多样性，专家们进一步合并了那些共享相同物体、几何结构、初始状态和目标事件，而仅在参数设置上存在差异的候选项。例如，在重力作用下沉降的两米高、由十个刚体组成的刚性堆叠结构，在其源论文中同时出现了质量缩放和无质量缩放两种情况；我们将其保留为一个单一任务。最终的基准测试包含从61篇参考论文中筛选出的168个任务。

paragraphs.en: A code scaffold is the complete simulation setup for a task with the solver removed. It defines what the scene contains and how it is observed, but not how the physics is computed: the numerical method is left entirely to the solver. Every task therefore differs only in its solver, which is the variable we evaluate.
paragraphs.zh: 代码框架是在移除求解器后，用于某项任务的完整模拟设置。它定义了场景包含的内容以及观察方式，但并未定义物理计算的方法：数值方法完全由求解器负责。因此，每项任务仅在其使用的求解器上存在差异，而求解器正是我们需要评估的变量。

paragraphs.en: To ensure scaffold correctness, we construct each scene through an iterative human-AI refinement procedure. A scaffold agent first produces an initial draft from the task description according to a common template. Human experts then refine the draft over successive iterations, executing it with a test solver to expose and correct errors in the scene specification. The test solver serves a diagnostic purpose only: its trajectories are not treated as physical ground truth, and no solver under evaluation is compared against them. A scaffold is accepted once the physical and rendered geometry are consistent, the target event is visible, and the scene and render contracts pass validation. Each scaffold adopts the following structure:
paragraphs.zh: 为确保脚手架的正确性，我们通过迭代式的人机协同优化流程来构建每个场景。首先，一个脚手架智能体根据通用模板从任务描述中生成初始草案。随后，人类专家在连续迭代中对该草案进行优化，并使用测试求解器执行草案，以暴露并修正场景规格中的错误。测试求解器仅用于诊断目的：其轨迹不被视为物理基准真值，且任何正在评估的求解器都不会与之进行比较。一旦物理几何与渲染几何一致、目标事件可见，并且场景和渲染契约通过验证，该脚手架即被视为合格。每个脚手架均采用以下结构：

paragraphs.en: Each solver agent received the frozen scaffold and a task prompt, and worked in a private workspace. The prompt supplied four authoritative blocks: the task definition, the public configuration, the scene geometry with its StateFrame bindings, and a task-specific Required raw trajectory outputs block giving the path, shape, and unit of every required field. These requirements were derived from the physics-metric bindings and the platform’s public trajectory-field vocabulary, so the agent exported raw physical state while the platform privately computed the physical plausibility scores. The agent could read the entire scaffold but modify only solver/** , with no network access, reference material, or files outside its workspace. Existing simulation engines were barred, so the physical model, discretization, and numerical scheme had to be derived from base scientific libraries. Specifically, the solver implemented three methods:
paragraphs.zh: 每个求解智能体都接收了冻结的框架和任务提示，并在一个私有工作空间中执行任务。该提示提供了四个权威模块：任务定义、公共配置、带有 StateFrame 绑定的场景几何结构，以及一个任务特定的“必需原始轨迹输出”模块，其中给出了每个必要字段的轨迹、形状和单位。这些要求源自物理量度绑定和平台的公共轨迹字段词汇表，因此智能体导出了原始物理状态，而平台则在内部计算了物理合理性得分。智能体可以读取整个框架，但只能修改 solver/** 部分，且无法访问网络、参考材料或工作空间以外的文件。现有的模拟引擎被禁止使用，因此物理模型、离散化和数值方案必须基于基础科学库自行实现。具体而言，该求解器实现了三种方法：

paragraphs.en: The solver was required to perform physical time stepping and to respect the frozen configuration, geometry, collisions, and state bindings. Hard-coded animations, keyframes, precomputed trajectories, and scene-specific motion tables were prohibited. Left unconstrained, a solver generation agent tends to keep designing a full engine, or to iterate on parameters indefinitely, and may submit nothing at all. Our prompt therefore pushed it toward an early deliverable: save a complete physically-based baseline well before the allowance is spent, verify it with a compile check, and make at most two focused correction passes for concrete syntax, interface, required-field, or obvious implementation errors found by inspection. No token or tool-call limit was stated.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器必须执行物理时间步长推进，并遵守冻结的配置、几何结构、碰撞和状态绑定。硬编码的动画、关键帧、预计算轨迹和场景特定的运动表均被禁止。若不受约束，求解器生成智能体往往会持续设计一个完整的引擎，或无限次迭代参数，甚至可能最终一无所提交。因此，我们的提示词引导其尽早交付成果：在配额耗尽之前，先保存一个完整的基于物理的基线版本，通过编译检查进行验证，然后最多进行两次有针对性的修正，以解决通过检查发现的语法、接口、必填字段或明显的实现错误。提示词未设定任何令牌或工具调用限制。

paragraphs.en: After submission the solver source was frozen, and the platform executed it, recorded the trajectory, rendered the video, and evaluated the result with no further source changes.
paragraphs.zh: 提交后，求解器的源代码被锁定，平台随后执行该代码、记录轨迹、渲染视频，并评估结果，期间源代码不再发生任何更改。

paragraphs.en: We separate the agent-generation environment from post-submission execution and evaluation. Agents run in disposable Debian Bookworm containers with only the assigned workspace mounted, holding NumPy, SciPy, Numba, h5py, PyYAML, and a bundled FFmpeg. The evaluation package is removed from these images, so the scoring metrics are hidden from the agents. Frozen submissions are then executed, rendered, and evaluated host-side by the platform. Rendering is performed by offscreen OpenGL rasterization through pyrender and PyOpenGL, trimesh for geometry processing, and ImageIO with FFmpeg for video encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体生成环境与提交后的执行和评估环节分离。智能体在一次性 Debian Bookworm 容器中运行，仅挂载指定的工作区，其中包含 NumPy、SciPy、Numba、h5py、PyYAML 以及一个打包好的 FFmpeg。这些镜像中移除了评估包，因此评分指标对智能体是隐藏的。随后，平台会在主机端执行已固化的提交结果，并进行渲染和评估。渲染过程通过 pyrender 和 PyOpenGL 实现离屏 OpenGL 光栅化，使用 trimesh 进行几何处理，以及 ImageIO 配合 FFmpeg 进行视频编码。

paragraphs.en: The execution check determines whether a submitted solver can run successfully and generate the required outputs. A case fails this check if it cannot export an evaluable trajectory and rendered video. Common failures include incomplete implementations, interface violations, runtime errors, numerical instability, and time exhaustion.
paragraphs.zh: 执行检查用于判断提交的求解器能否成功运行并生成所需的输出。如果某个案例无法导出可评估的轨迹和渲染后的视频，则视为未通过此项检查。常见的失败原因包括实现不完整、违反接口规范、运行时错误、数值不稳定以及时间耗尽等。

paragraphs.en: Our visual fidelity evaluation is divided into four parts: task-specific visual criteria construction, uniform frame sampling, VLM-based judging, and repeated score aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的视觉保真度评估分为四个部分：任务特定的视觉标准构建、统一帧采样、基于VLM的评判以及重复得分聚合。

paragraphs.en: Part 1: Task-specific visual criteria. For every task, we construct four visual criteria from the target physical phenomenon and its required events. The criteria follow four shared dimensions: event_sequence , interaction_response , signature_phenomenon , and temporal_coherence . As an example, the Cube Drop Water task considers a rigid cube entering water, producing a splash and wake, and subsequently moving according to its buoyant response. Its task-specific visual criteria are shown below.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 部分：任务特定的视觉标准。对于每个任务，我们从目标物理现象及其所需事件中构建四个视觉标准。这些标准遵循四个共同的维度：事件序列（event_sequence）、交互响应（interaction_response）、特征现象（signature_phenomenon）和时间连贯性（temporal_coherence）。例如，“立方体落水”任务会考虑一个刚性立方体进入水中，产生水花和尾迹，并随后根据其浮力响应移动。其任务特定的视觉标准如下所示。

paragraphs.en: This sampling includes the first and last frames. The sampled frames are kept in chronological order, resized so that each side is at most 768 pixels, and encoded as JPEG images. Each image is labeled with its temporal position, such as (frame 1/20) .
paragraphs.zh: 此采样包含第一帧和最后一帧。采样后的帧按时间顺序保留，经过调整大小以确保每条边的像素最多为 768 像素，并以 JPEG 图像格式进行编码。每幅图像都标有其时间位置，例如（第 1/20 帧）。

paragraphs.en: Part 3: VLM-based judging. We use GPT-5.6-Sol as the visual judge. The 20 ordered frames and the task-specific visual criteria are supplied in the same request. The judge assigns each criterion a score between 0 and 1 and provides a short evidence statement. The key prompt content is shown below.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 部分：基于 VLM 的评判。我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 作为视觉评判者。20 个有序帧和任务特定的视觉标准会一同提供在同一个请求中。评判者为每个标准分配一个介于 0 和 1 之间的分数，并提供简短的证据说明。关键提示内容如下所示。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows an example of how VLM outputs score based on the evidence together. The GPT-5.6-Sol solver output shows a partially immersed cube with strong surface deformation but the splash is not clear enough.
paragraphs.zh: 图8展示了一个示例，说明VLM如何根据证据共同输出分数。GPT-5.6-Sol求解器的输出显示了一个部分浸入水中的立方体，其表面发生了明显的形变，但水花不够清晰。

paragraphs.en: Part 4: Repeated evaluation and score aggregation. We evaluate the same key frames five times using the same prompt. For each criterion, we average the five returned scores. The final visual score is the average of the four averaged criterion scores. The visual fidelity score for the Cube Drop Water task is shown below.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 部分：重复评估与分数汇总。我们使用相同的提示，对同一组关键帧进行五次评估。对于每个标准，我们对五次返回的分数取平均值。最终的视觉分数是四个标准化准则分数的平均值。Cube Drop Water 任务的视觉保真度分数如下所示。

paragraphs.en: Example interpretation. The cube entry is clearly visible and therefore receives the highest criterion score. The splash, subsequent buoyant motion, and overall temporal coherence are also captured, although the cube–water interface is less clear in some frames. The criterion-level results expose visual weaknesses that would be hidden by reporting only the final score.
paragraphs.zh: 示例解读。立方体的画面清晰可见，因此获得了最高的标准分。水花、随后的浮力运动以及整体的时间连贯性也得到了呈现，尽管在某些帧中立方体与水的界面不够清晰。标准级别的结果揭示了仅报告最终分数时会隐藏的视觉缺陷。

paragraphs.en: The physical plausibility evaluation is divided into three parts: task-specific criterion binding, deterministic calculator execution, and result inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 物理合理性评估分为三个部分：任务特定的标准绑定、确定性计算器执行以及结果检查。

paragraphs.en: Part 1: Task-specific physical criteria and calculator bindings. Physical criteria are selected according to the domain and target phenomenon of each task. Each criterion contains a dimension that groups related physical properties, while the calculator specifies the numerical check to execute. As an example, we use the GPT-5.6-Sol result for the Billiard Impulse Chain task. The task evaluates nonpenetrating contact, linear momentum balance, center-of-mass consistency, and internal interaction-force balance. We fully expand the first binding below and abbreviate the remaining entries.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 部分：任务特定的物理标准与计算器绑定。物理标准根据每个任务的领域和目标现象进行选择。每个标准都包含一个维度，用于对相关的物理属性进行分组，而计算器则指定了需要执行的数值检查。例如，我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 在“台球冲量链”任务中的结果。该任务评估非穿透接触、线性动量平衡、质心一致性和内部相互作用力平衡。我们在下方完整展开第一个绑定，其余条目则使用缩写表示。

paragraphs.en: The names on the left side of the inputs block are calculator arguments, and the values on the right are paths to the corresponding trajectory fields. The parameters block provides additional fixed settings, while reduction specifies how the per-frame errors are combined.
paragraphs.zh: 输入块左侧的名称是计算器参数，右侧的值则是相应轨迹字段的路径。参数块提供额外的固定设置，而 reduction 则指定了每帧误差的组合方式。

paragraphs.en: Part 2: Deterministic calculator execution. The evaluator resolves the input paths, executes the selected calculator over the trajectory, and reduces its per-frame errors to one normalized error. The central execution logic is:
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 部分：确定性计算器执行。评估器解析输入路径，在轨迹上执行所选的计算器，并将其每帧误差归约为一个归一化误差。核心执行逻辑如下：

paragraphs.en: The contact calculator measures the deepest ball–ball or ball–support penetration relative to the contact length scale. The momentum calculator compares the change in total system momentum with the exported external forces. The center-of-mass calculator compares each ball’s observed displacement with the displacement obtained by integrating its velocity. The interaction-force calculator checks whether the exported internal contact forces cancel in aggregate.
paragraphs.zh: 接触计算器测量相对于接触长度尺度的最深球–球或球–支撑穿透深度。动量计算器将系统总动量的变化与导出的外力进行比较。质心计算器将每个球的观测位移与其速度积分得到的位移进行比较。相互作用力计算器检查导出的内部接触力在总体上是否相互抵消。

paragraphs.en: Part 3: Example results. For the Billiard Impulse Chain example, we fully expand the first result. The remaining entries follow the same structure and retain only the fields needed for identification and comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 部分：示例结果。对于“台球脉冲链”示例，我们对第一个结果进行了完整展开。其余条目遵循相同结构，并仅保留用于识别和比较的字段。

paragraphs.en: The result contains no detected penetration, and the exported internal contact forces cancel correctly. The center-of-mass error is 0.101, with a maximum position residual of approximately 0.0149 0.0149 meters. However, the total momentum change is inconsistent with the exported external-force record, producing a momentum-balance error of 1.0 1.0 . The simulation therefore receives a physical score of 73.734 73.734 , compared with a visual score of 99.5 99.5 . It reproduces the expected motion convincingly in the rendered video, while the trajectory reveals a momentum inconsistency that is difficult to detect visually.
paragraphs.zh: 结果中未检测到任何穿透现象，且导出的内部接触力也正确抵消。质心误差为 0.101，最大位置残差约为 0.0149 0.0149 米。然而，总动量变化与导出的外力记录不一致，导致动量平衡误差为 1.0 1.0 。因此，该模拟的物理评分为 73.734 73.734 ，而视觉评分则为 99.5 99.5 。在渲染的视频中，它确实再现了预期的运动，但其轨迹却暴露出一个难以通过肉眼察觉的动量不一致问题。

paragraphs.en: To examine the complementarity of Visual Fidelity and Physical Plausibility, we present a fine-grained case study that illustrates the behavior of our metric. Specifically, we group the results into three categories: Visually Correct but Physically Incorrect, Physically Correct but Visually Inaccurate, and Metrics in Agreement. Each category is illustrated with four pairs of cases, accompanied by a clarification that traces the judgment back to its root cause. Together, these examples show that neither score is sufficient in isolation: visual fidelity evaluates whether the expected phenomenon is visibly reproduced, whereas physical plausibility tests whether the generated dynamics satisfy the selected quantitative constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究视觉保真度与物理合理性之间的互补性，我们提出了一项细致的案例研究，用以说明我们指标的行为。具体而言，我们将结果分为三类：视觉上正确但物理上不正确、物理上正确但视觉上不准确，以及指标一致的情况。每一类都通过四对案例进行说明，并附有解释，追溯判断的根本原因。这些例子共同表明，单独使用任一评分都不足以全面评估：视觉保真度用于判断预期现象是否在视觉上被准确再现，而物理合理性则检验生成的动态过程是否符合所选的定量约束条件。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 simulates a square cloth sheet falling onto a sharp edge and an isolated point. Claude-Opus-5 and Qwen-3.8-Max obtain relatively similar visual scores, because both videos show the expected falling cloth, obstacle interaction, and folded resting configuration. However, the physical evaluation separates the two solutions much more clearly. The main differences arise from the orientation_preserving_deformation and nonpenetrating_contact criteria. Qwen-3.8-Max’s simulation remains visually recognizable as draping cloth, but its physical trajectory contains extensive element inversion and obstacle interpenetration that are difficult to diagnose from rendered frames alone.
paragraphs.zh: 图9模拟了一块方形布片落在锐利边缘和孤立点上的过程。Claude-Opus-5 和 Qwen-3.8-Max 获得了相对接近的视觉评分，因为两段视频都展示了预期的布料下落、与障碍物的相互作用以及折叠后的静止状态。然而，物理评估则更清晰地区分了这两种方案。主要差异源于 orientation_preserving_deformation（方向保持形变）和 nonpenetrating_contact（无穿透接触）这两个标准。Qwen-3.8-Max 的模拟在视觉上仍然可以识别为垂落的布料，但其物理轨迹中存在大量的元素倒置和与障碍物的相互穿透，仅凭渲染出的帧画面难以诊断出这些问题。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 10 , Gemini-3.7-Flash and Claude-Opus-5 both receive relatively high visual scores because both videos show the tube expanding outward while retaining its constrained ends. However, the physical evaluation clearly favors Gemini-3.7-Flash. The main difference arises from the quasistatic_nodal_force_balance criteria. Claude-Opus-5 produces a plausible inflated silhouette, but its unconstrained material nodes have large residual forces, indicating that the displayed configuration is not close to mechanical equilibrium.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 10 所示，Gemini-3.7-Flash 和 Claude-Opus-5 都获得了相对较高的视觉评分，因为两段视频都展示了管体在保持两端受约束的同时向外膨胀。然而，物理评估结果明显更倾向于 Gemini-3.7-Flash。主要差异源于准静态节点力平衡标准。Claude-Opus-5 生成的充气轮廓看似合理，但其未受约束的材料节点存在较大的残余力，表明所显示的结构尚未接近力学平衡状态。

paragraphs.en: The task shown in Figure 11 simulates a rubber cube compressed vertically between a support and a loaded top face. The distinction of their physical plausibility score is primarily produced by the quasistatic_nodal_force_balance . Gemini-3.7-Flash reproduces the expected macroscopic shape, but its trajectory contains a much larger node-wise force residual, which cannot be determined reliably from the rendered surface alone.
paragraphs.zh: 图 11 中展示的任务模拟了一个橡胶立方体在支撑结构与受载顶面之间被垂直压缩的情形。它们物理合理性得分的差异主要由 quasistatic_nodal_force_balance 决定。Gemini-3.7-Flash 再现了预期的宏观形状，但其轨迹中节点层面的力残余量要大得多，而仅凭渲染出的表面是无法可靠地确定这一点的。

paragraphs.en: In figure 12 , both agents simulate the characteristic axial banding pattern. While GPT-5.6-Sol produces convincing visible bands, it fails to respect the particle_fluid_force_balance criterion. Specifically, its exported particle-to-fluid and fluid-to-particle forces fail to cancel, revealing an inconsistent momentum exchange that is not observable in the rendered video.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 12 中，两个智能体都模拟出了特征性的轴向条带模式。尽管 GPT-5.6-Sol 生成了令人信服的可见条带，但它未能满足 particle_fluid_force_balance（粒子-流体力平衡）标准。具体而言，其导出的粒子对流体和流体对粒子的力未能相互抵消，暴露出一种在渲染视频中无法观察到的不一致动量交换。

paragraphs.en: This task simulates a parabolic arch assembled from rigid blocks that should remain standing through frictional contact. As shown in Figure 13 , Kimi-K2.7-Code preserves the arch, whereas GLM-5.3 rapidly loses the intended structure. However, their physical scores are nearly identical because none of the evaluated criteria directly verifies if the complete arch remains standing. The visual fidelity score complements this gap by directly recognizing the stable arch as the signature outcome and strongly penalizing the collapsed scene.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务模拟了一个由刚性块组装而成的抛物线拱形结构，其稳定性应通过摩擦力接触得以维持。如图 13 所示，Kimi-K2.7-Code 成功保留了拱形结构，而 GLM-5.3 则迅速失去了预期的结构。然而，它们的物理评分几乎完全相同，因为所评估的标准中没有任何一项直接验证了完整的拱形结构是否保持直立。视觉保真度评分则弥补了这一差距：它直接将稳定的拱形结构识别为典型结果，并对坍塌的场景给予严厉扣分。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 14 , we provide a simulation where a tendril-covered elastic ball impacting a wall, flattening, and quickly recovering its rounded shape. Claude-Opus-5 reproduces the impact and recovery, whereas GPT-5.6-Sol remains almost static. Nevertheless, GPT-5.6-Sol receives a relatively high physical score because physical criteria such as linear_momentum_impulse_balance do not directly require an impact to occur. A nearly static trajectory can conserve mass, avoid element inversion, and maintain a small budget residual while omitting the target phenomenon entirely.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 14 中，我们展示了一个模拟场景：一个覆盖着触须的弹性球撞击墙壁后发生扁平化，并迅速恢复其圆形形状。Claude-Opus-5 成功再现了撞击和恢复过程，而 GPT-5.6-Sol 则几乎保持静止。尽管如此，GPT-5.6-Sol 仍然获得了相对较高的物理分数，因为诸如 linear_momentum_impulse_balance 之类的物理标准并不直接要求发生撞击。一个近乎静止的轨迹可以保持质量守恒、避免元素倒置，并维持较小的预算残差，同时完全忽略了目标现象本身。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 15 , we provide a task in which incoming airflow should accelerate a dynamic rotor and produce a visible helical smoke wake. GPT-5.6-Sol barely responds, yet it still receives a perfect physical score: its nearly static state drives both sides of the angular_momentum_torque_budget , solid_fluid_exchange_force_balance , and impermeable_interface_normal_velocity balances to approximately zero. However, visual fidelity closes this loophole, checking rotor acceleration, smoke transport, and the helical wake directly against the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 15 所示，我们设置了一项任务：流入的气流应使一个动态转子加速，并产生可见的螺旋形烟雾尾迹。GPT-5.6-Sol 几乎未作响应，但仍获得了完美的物理分数：其近乎静止的状态使得 angular_momentum_torque_budget、solid_fluid_exchange_force_balance 和 impermeable_interface_normal_velocity 这两个平衡项两侧的数值均接近于零。然而，视觉保真度机制填补了这一漏洞，通过直接对比场景中的转子加速、烟雾输运以及螺旋形尾迹来验证这些要素。

paragraphs.en: The task in Figure 16 simulates a knitted scarf sliding down an incline and accumulating into thick bunched folds. Their physical scores are almost identical because both conserve mass, remain within the allowed surface-strain range, and avoid measured contact penetration, while both have similarly poor momentum-balance residuals. However, only GLM-5.3 reproduces the expected cloth pile, while in Claude-Opus-5 the scarf flies off the edge.
paragraphs.zh: 图 16 中的任务模拟了一条针织围巾沿斜面下滑并堆积成厚厚褶皱的过程。两者的物理评分几乎完全相同，因为它们都保持了质量守恒、处于允许的表面应变范围内，并且避免了可测量的接触穿透；同时，两者的动量平衡残差也同样不佳。然而，只有 GLM-5.3 再现了预期的织物堆积效果，而在 Claude-Opus-5 中，围巾则飞出了边缘。

paragraphs.en: As a complementary set of examples, these cases show agreement between the two metrics. Successful solvers reproduce the target phenomenon while satisfying the physical criteria, whereas unsuccessful solvers fail both visually and physically. Together, they illustrate that the two evaluations are consistent when solver quality isn’t ambiguous.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一组补充示例，这些案例显示两种评估指标之间存在一致性。成功的求解器能够在满足物理标准的同时重现目标现象，而失败的求解器则在视觉和物理层面均未能达到要求。综合来看，这些案例表明，当求解器的质量没有歧义时，这两种评估方法是相互一致的。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 shows broadly consistent performance trends between visual and physics scores, together with systematic differences across domains. In rigid-body dynamics, every model scores higher visually than physically. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol obtains 65.5% versus 44.2%. This gap suggests that visually plausible motion can coexist with violations detected by the physical checks, demonstrating the necessity of physical evaluation. The pattern reverses for plastic and complex materials, where physics scores consistently exceed visual scores, suggesting that, in certain domains, even minor violations of physical constraints by a solver can lead to poor visual results. The two criteria therefore provide complementary evidence: visual evaluation assesses observable fidelity, while physics evaluation checks constraints that plausible-looking outputs may nevertheless violate.
paragraphs.zh: 图18显示，视觉得分与物理得分的性能趋势总体上保持一致，但不同领域间也存在系统性差异。在刚体动力学中，所有模型在视觉上的得分均高于物理得分。例如，GPT-5.6-Sol的视觉得分为65.5%，而物理得分仅为44.2%。这一差距表明，看似合理的运动可能与物理检查所发现的违规行为同时存在，从而凸显了物理评估的必要性。对于塑料和复杂材料，这一模式则恰好相反：物理得分始终高于视觉得分，这表明在某些领域，求解器对物理约束的轻微违反也可能导致较差的视觉效果。因此，这两种评估标准提供了互补的证据：视觉评估用于衡量可观察的保真度，而物理评估则用于检查那些看似合理的输出可能仍然违反的物理约束。

paragraphs.en: To verify the stability of the VLM judge, we repeat the visual-fidelity evaluation of each task five times. Figure 19 reports the mean scores per domain, with error bars indicating the mean standard deviation within the task in the five evaluations. The error bars are generally small across agents and physical domains, showing that repeated evaluations produce consistent scores. Slightly larger variations appear in some cases, but the overall performance patterns remain stable. These results suggest that our VLM judge provides consistent visual-fidelity evaluations reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证VLM判定的稳定性，我们对每个任务的视觉保真度进行了五次重复评估。图19报告了各领域的平均得分，误差棒表示五次评估中该任务内的平均标准差。在各个智能体和物理领域，误差棒普遍较小，表明重复评估能够产生一致的得分。某些情况下会出现略微较大的差异，但整体性能模式仍然保持稳定。这些结果表明，我们的VLM判定能够可靠地提供一致的视觉保真度评估。

paragraphs.en: Our Visual Fidelity evaluation consists of four task-specific criteria for each case, which are assessed by a VLM using a shared set of key frames. To validate this evaluation protocol against human judgment, we asked expert annotators to assess solver quality using the same key frames and evaluation criteria. Among the 661 cases with successfully rendered videos, we sampled 231 cases for human evaluation, including 40 overlapping cases rated by multiple annotators to measure Human-Human consistency. As shown in Table 4 , the VLM scores show strong agreement with human judgments in both absolute values (Pearson r = 0.730 r=0.730 ) and rank ordering (Spearman ρ = 0.713 \rho=0.713 ). For comparison, Human-Human correlations on the shared cases are lower, with Pearson r = 0.624 r=0.624 and Spearman ρ = 0.607 \rho=0.607 . These results indicate that the VLM-based evaluation aligns well with expert judgments and achieves correlations, in this sample higher, than those observed between individual human annotators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的视觉保真度评估包含针对每个案例的四项任务特定标准，这些标准由一个视觉语言模型（VLM）使用共享的关键帧集进行评估。为了验证该评估协议与人类判断的一致性，我们邀请专家标注员使用相同的关键帧和评估标准来评估求解器的质量。在成功渲染视频的 661 个案例中，我们抽取了 231 个案例进行人类评估，其中包括 40 个由多位标注员共同评分的重叠案例，用于衡量“人类-人类”一致性。如表 4 所示，VLM 的评分在绝对值（皮尔逊相关系数 r = 0.730 r=0.730）和排名顺序（斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ = 0.713 \rho=0.713）方面均与人类判断高度一致。相比之下，共享案例中“人类-人类”的相关性较低，皮尔逊相关系数为 r = 0.624 r=0.624，斯皮尔曼相关系数为 ρ = 0.607 \rho=0.607。这些结果表明，基于 VLM 的评估与专家判断高度吻合，并且在本样本中，其相关性甚至高于不同人类标注员之间的相关性。

paragraphs.en: To grasp a view of each agent’s output solver style, we further provide the size and runtime efficiency of the generated solvers in Table 5 . Being the best performance model, GPT-5.6-Sol also produces the most compact implementations, averaging 234 lines and 1,028 words, while achieving the shortest execution time of 22.78 seconds. Though showing comparable performance, Claude-Opus-5 attains a comparable benchmark score, but its solvers are the longest on average and have the highest mean execution time (100.79 seconds). GLM-5.3 has the lowest mean memory consumption (235.81 MiB), but its solvers are longer than those of GPT-5.6-Sol in context. Overall, solver size and resource usage vary substantially across agents, even when their performance scores are similar.
paragraphs.zh: 为了了解每个智能体所生成的求解器的风格，我们在表 5 中进一步提供了这些求解器的规模以及运行时效率。作为性能最佳的模型，GPT-5.6-Sol 也生成了最紧凑的实现，平均包含 234 行代码和 1,028 个单词，同时实现了最短的执行时间（22.78 秒）。尽管 Claude-Opus-5 表现出相当的性能并获得了相近的基准分数，但其生成的求解器平均长度最长，平均执行时间也最高（100.79 秒）。GLM-5.3 的平均内存消耗最低（235.81 MiB），但其求解器的上下文长度比 GPT-5.6-Sol 更长。总体而言，即使智能体之间的性能分数相近，它们所生成求解器的规模和资源使用量仍存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Figures 20 and 21 report per-task agent wall time and token usage, respectively. The heatmaps reveal substantial variation across both agents and tasks: some agents consistently consume more time or tokens, while certain tasks require considerably greater resources across multiple agents. These task-level results suggest that the computational difficulty of solver generation is highly uneven and depends on both the physical phenomena and the agent’s problem-solving ability.
paragraphs.zh: 图20和图21分别报告了每个任务的智能体实际运行时间和令牌使用量。热图显示，不同智能体和任务之间存在显著差异：某些智能体持续消耗更多时间或令牌，而某些任务则需要在多个智能体中占用更多资源。这些任务层面的结果表明，求解器生成的计算难度极不均衡，既取决于物理现象本身，也取决于智能体的问题解决能力。
